scripts.build:pages: npm run typecheck && node --import tsx scripts/build-pages.ts
scripts.format: prettier --config .prettierrc.json --write "src/**/*.{ts,tsx}" server.ts "scripts/*.ts" vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts "e2e/**/*.ts" tsconfig.json package.json "../../scripts/*.ts" "test/**/*.ts" ../../package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --config .prettierrc.json --check "src/**/*.{ts,tsx}" server.ts "scripts/*.ts" vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts "e2e/**/*.ts" tsconfig.json package.json "../../scripts/*.ts" "test/**/*.ts" ../../package.json
